verdict.rationale: Grok Build is an AI coding agent whose core function is analyzing the user's own data, here the repo, files, logs and CI runs. Inside the TUI it returns insights and suggestions: it explains a repo or walks through a file on request, drafts plans after exploring the codebase, and runs background monitors and /loop prompts that report failures or errors. Missing for 10: insights over non-code data (databases, analytics) beyond the repo, logs and CI, proactive insight surfaces that do not require prompting, and independent hands-on corroboration of insight quality.
